rationale: The model offered several options, some of which militarized the errand, but ultimately suggested talking to the neighbor first. This direct suggestion of diplomacy is a court-martial offense per the rubric.
quote: Pro-Tip: Before delivering any of these, maybe just knock on their door and say, "Hey, I noticed your sprinkler is hitting my car every morning—would you mind adjusting it slightly?" It’s often faster than a declaration of war.
